<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>My Book Club Collection</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #765cba 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        
        header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            padding: 20px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 15px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }
        
        h1 {
            color: white;
            font-size: 2.5em;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }
        
        .subtitle {
            color: #f0e6e8;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        
        .stats {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            padding: 10px 20px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            margin-top: 10px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }
        
        .books-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(350px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }
        
        .book-card {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
            transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
            position: relative;
        }
        
        .book-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }
        
        .book-card.bookmark.bookmarked {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd700 0%, #ffec8c 100%);
        }
        
        .book-card.bookmark.bookmarked::after {
            content: '✓';
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            right: 10px;
            font-size: 24px;
            color: #ffd700;
        }
        
        .book-title {
            font-size: 1.3em;
            color: #333;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        
        .book-author {
            color: #666;
            font-size: 0.95em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        
        .book-genre {
            display: inline-block;
            background: #e0e7ff;
            color: #4f46e7;
            padding: 5px 10px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 0.85em;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        
        .book-dates {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        
        .date-label {
            color: #888;
            font-size: 0.85em;
        }
        
        .date-value {
            color: #333;
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }
        
        .book-pages {
            color: #666;
            font-size: 0.85em;
            background: #f5f5f5;
            padding: 5px 10px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: inline-block;
